description: Locally reviewed hypotheses, not MITRE-supplied transition probabilities or tactic ordering. Future prerequisites are never assumed satisfied.

rules.rationale: A valid account with execution privileges may be used to run PowerShell; account possession alone does not establish execution.
Elevated PowerShell execution creates an opportunity for attempted LSASS credential access; host protections may prevent it.
Credential access may enable attempted SMB lateral movement where an explicit can_access relationship supports reachability. Remote authorization remains an assumption.
